blockers.tried: roughness 0.1..1 on rolling, low-passed at 700 Hz
blockers.workaround: dropped the macro; used a weight macro (centroid -1) instead

blockers.wanted: a 'knock' macro raising the level of the wooden stop (a secondary event)
blockers.tried: mix input gain 0.8..4 then 2..14 with claim crest +1
blockers.workaround: dropped it; the stop does not set the peak and lufs normalization flattens level changes so crest is non-monotone (16.3 -> 16.2 -> 16.0 -> 16.6 -> 16.8)

blockers.wanted: one-node speed profile into rolling plus a matching filter sweep
blockers.tried: env with smooth curve for speed and for filter freq, reading each by node name
blockers.workaround: worked, but no doc says 'use env for speed contour'; rolling fed to modal is broadband and loud above 500 Hz so it needed extra lp/hp filters

blockers.wanted: measure that the rumble's pitch rises then falls
blockers.tried: centroid by tenth: 126 194 190 192 190 182 140 182 233; filter freq envelope 110 -> 320 -> 140
blockers.workaround: relied on the spectrogram image; the centroid is nearly flat because modal resonances pin it near 190 Hz, so the target (rise then fall) is only weakly measurable

a drawer / sliding-runner model (rolling plus box resonance in one node)
a listen readout of the spectral peak track over time for a rise-and-fall
